fixture_notice: Synthetic claim-selection audit samples; no real episode, speaker, claim, or model evaluation is represented.
sampling_note: Purposefully balanced teaching sample. Precision and recall describe only these six examples, not production performance.

samples.transcript_excerpt: The sample program enrolled 20,000 people last year.

machine_candidate.text: The sample program enrolled 20,000 people last year.

samples.canonical_claim_text: The sample program enrolled 20,000 people during the previous calendar year.
samples.review_note: The machine preserved the bounded quantity and time period; the editor normalized wording without changing meaning.

samples.transcript_excerpt: Wouldn't every sensible city copy an idea this obvious?

machine_candidate.text: Every sensible city would copy the idea.

samples.review_note: A rhetorical question was incorrectly converted into an asserted factual generalization.

samples.transcript_excerpt: My neighbor joined after the fee fell from forty dollars to ten.
samples.canonical_claim_text: The sample program fee fell from $40 to $10 before the neighbor joined.
samples.review_note: The anecdote contains a checkable quantitative premise even though the personal decision itself is not generalizable.

samples.transcript_excerpt: Enrollment rose because the new rule removed the fee.

machine_candidate.text: Removing the fee caused enrollment to rise.

samples.canonical_claim_text: Removing the sample program fee caused enrollment to increase.
samples.review_note: The causal assertion is explicit and must remain separate from any descriptive enrollment count.

samples.transcript_excerpt: Thanks for having me; it is great to be here.
samples.review_note: Conversational courtesy is preserved in the transcript but is not a claim-selection target.

samples.transcript_excerpt: I bet the program reaches a million people next year.

machine_candidate.text: The program will reach one million people next year.

samples.review_note: The forecast is preserved for later evaluation but excluded from the current-fact truth-score denominator.
